column5: GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/evaluation_accounting.rs:499-501, 525-527`: a non-recording `EvaluationAccounting` builds and validates no receipt, so evaluation is unmetered. Whether a production caller uses the default was not traced.

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/const_evaluation.rs:307-309` (checked): a `Named` type argument with an invalid symbol counts as closed. Reader: "A wrong type name with no resolved symbol would also count as closed."

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/const_evaluation.rs:1794-1807` (checked): the zero gate is cleared after looking at the first variant's `where` facts only. A data type whose later variant has facts is judged by the first. What the gate guards was not traced.

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/const_evaluation.rs:4933, 5019-5034`: a failed range-endpoint round or root with no pending calls is left unfolded with no diagnostic. Which later stage rejects it was not traced.

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/const_generic_expressions.rs:1814-1821`: operator selections in callee bodies are not recorded in custody. `:1837-1866`: selection kinds other than Call, Operator or a resolved Const are ignored. `:1349-1361`: a `TransitionNamed` call inside a reflection body held by the same machine returns `Ok(())` with no custody check.

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/const_generic_expressions.rs:2689-2695, 5680-5686`: in the `Closed` context, `&& || & | ^ << >>` are evaluated with builtin meaning with no operator check. Whether an overload can exist on builtin scalar operands was not traced.
GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/const_initializers.rs:940-942`: any expression passes the carrier check when the destination is primitive. Not every path traced.

GROUP: **Build-time evaluation** | - `BTE/const_initializers.rs:2188-2191, 2238-2240`: replay validation skips declarations without calls or float components (inferred: these cannot hold call receipts).
